scope: Reviewed Etna declarations that make a name, written inside their namespace, resolve to them instead of an existing outer declaration or alias. The audit fails on any unlisted or stale pair.

entries.reason: Block field holding the forced-inclusion singleton result; Init's Singleton.singleton is never meant inside namespace Block.
Forced-inclusion singleton execution outcome type; Forced theorems and manifest types intentionally mean this type, not Init's Singleton class.
Step constructor for the rollback transition, whose effect is the rollback function it shadows only inside namespace Step.
SoundStep constructor for a rollback under a sound environment, whose effect is the rollback function it shadows only inside namespace SoundStep.
World-level landing wrapper; ProtocolState always writes Etna.Design.land in full when it means the inbox-level transition.
Snapshot field storing recorded entries; the State-level entries function is distinct and only shadowed inside namespace Snapshot.
Registry history state machine; RegistryHistory statements intentionally mean this State and write the inbox state as Etna.Design.State in full.
SignalService checkpoint hash field; Hashable.hash is never meant inside namespace Signal.
Durable signer high-water-mark state; Signer statements intentionally mean this State, not the inbox State.
Derived DecidableEq instance for Signer.State; instances are found by type class resolution, not by this name.
Derived Repr instance for Signer.State; instances are found by type class resolution, not by this name.
